a: Use header, main, nav, article, section, footer for accessible structure.
Content + padding + border (+ margin outside) determine element size.
Flex is one-dimensional; Grid is two-dimensional layout.
Layouts adapt across screen sizes via fluid units and media queries.
Meaningful alt text describes images for screen readers; decorative images use empty alt.
The DOM is the browser tree; virtual DOM diffs minimize real DOM updates.
SPAs navigate client-side; MPAs load new documents per navigation.
CSR renders in the browser; SSR sends HTML from the server first.
LCP, INP, and CLS measure loading, interactivity, and visual stability.
Service workers intercept fetches for offline and performance caching.
